questions.question: Explain two reasons why zakah is important for Muslims.
questions.correctAnswer: 1) Zakah purifies wealth — by giving away 2.5% of their surplus, Muslims acknowledge that all wealth ultimately belongs to Allah and they are merely its stewards. Hoarding wealth is condemned in the Qur'an. 2) Zakah reduces inequality — it redistributes wealth from the rich to the poor, ensuring everyone's basic needs are met.
